name_zh: 罗马尼亚·多伊娜·布鲁塞：知识分子异见与极权真理
name_en: Romania Doina Braes: Intellectual Dissent & Totalitarian Truth
description_zh: 多伊娜·布鲁塞 (1940-2018) 罗马尼亚异见知识分子，哲学教授，签署77年《人权宣言》被开除党籍，流亡法国继续揭露齐奥塞斯库暴行，回国后推动记忆与真相委员会建设。
description_en: Doina Braes (1940-2018) Romanian dissident intellectual, philosophy professor, signed 1977 Human Rights Declaration expelled from Party, exiled France continued exposing Ceausescu atrocities, returned promoted memory and truth commission construction.
reason_zh: 布鲁塞代表东欧极权体制下知识分子良知坚守与真理追寻，展示了异见者如何在监控社会中维护人性尊严，为后极权时代真相与和解奠基。
reason_en: Braes represents Eastern European intellectual conscience坚守 and truth pursuit under totalitarianism, demonstrating how dissenters maintain human dignity in surveillance society, laying foundation for post-totalitarian truth and reconciliation.
steps_zh: 研究布鲁塞早年哲学教育与马克思主义人道主义
分析1977年签署人权宣言与党内开除经历
探讨法国流亡期揭露齐奥塞斯库体制暴行
评估1989革命后回国推动记忆真相委员会
总结异见知识分子良知传承与罗马尼亚转型正义
steps_en: Study Braes early philosophy education and Marxist humanism
Analyze 1977 Human Rights Declaration signing and Party expulsion
Explore France exile exposing Ceausescu regime atrocities
Evaluate 1989 post-revolution return promoting memory truth commission
Summarize dissident intellectual conscience transmission and Romanian transitional justice
expected_zh: 理解极权体制下知识分子异见的道德代价与真理力量，掌握异见者生存策略与转型正义推动机制，评估其对东欧记忆政治的深远影响。
expected_en: Understand moral cost of intellectual dissent under totalitarianism and truth power, grasp dissident survival strategy and transitional justice driving mechanism, evaluate its profound impact on Eastern European memory politics.
case_zh: 1977 签署人权宣言被开除；1981 流亡法国；1989 革命回国；2000s 推动锡盖特纪念馆建设。知识分子异见极权真理永存。
case_en: 1977 signed Human Rights Declaration expelled; 1981 exiled France; 1989 revolution returned; 2000s promoted Sighet Memorial construction. Intellectual dissent totalitarian truth endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Dissident conscience model; transitional justice; memory politics
